body.script:
var DL_META = {
  'new':{tag:'New',bg:'linear-gradient(135deg,#1565c0,#1a237e)',tagbg:'#1a6b55',title:'Driving License - New',
    desc:'
A new driving license application service for first-time applicants in the UAE.
Requirement(s)
Original NOC from the freezone to open driving license file
Original passport with valid visa for at least 6 months
Original Emirates ID
Passport style photo (x4)
Timeline
30-60 business days
Fees
AED 1,890'},
  'amendment':{tag:'Amend',bg:'linear-gradient(135deg,#4a5568,#2d3748)',tagbg:'#4a5568',title:'Driving License - Amendment',
    desc:'
Amendment service for updating details on an existing UAE driving license.
Fees
AED 378'},
  'duplicate':{tag:'Duplicate',bg:'linear-gradient(135deg,#6b2fa0,#4a1080)',tagbg:'#6b2fa0',title:'Driving License - Duplicate',
    desc:'
Obtain a duplicate of your existing UAE driving license.
Fees
AED 1,285'},
  'renewal':{tag:'Renew',bg:'linear-gradient(135deg,#1a6b3c,#145a32)',tagbg:'#1a6b3c',title:'Driving License - Renewal',
    desc:'
Renew your UAE driving license before expiry.
Fees
AED 1,285'},
  'transfer':{tag:'Transfer',bg:'linear-gradient(135deg,#c0392b,#922b21)',tagbg:'#922b21',title:'Driving License - Transfer',
    desc:'
Driving license transfer is the process of obtaining a license from a different country without having to undertake classes, trainings and tests. This is applicable to the 51 countries allowed visa-on-arrival.
Requirement(s)
Original NOC from the Free Zone
Original passport and visa valid for at least 6 months
Original Emirates ID
Original driving license
Copy of original driving license
Arabic legal translation of driving license
Four(4) Passport size photos
Eye Test done in any RTA affiliated center
Timeline
1-2 business days
Fees
AED 1,010'},
};
var parts = window.location.pathname.split('/');
var dlType = parts[parts.length-2];
var meta = DL_META[dlType] || DL_META['new'];
document.getElementById('detailTitle').textContent = meta.title;
document.getElementById('heroBanner').style.background = meta.bg;
document.getElementById('heroTag').textContent = meta.tag;
document.getElementById('heroTag').style.background = meta.tagbg;
document.getElementById('detailDesc').innerHTML = meta.desc;
document.getElementById('startBtn').href = '/spc/concierge/driving-license/'+dlType+'/step1';

div.p: Please submit below documents to SPC:

• Original NOC from the freezone to open driving license file
• Original passport with valid visa for at least 6 months
• Original Emirates ID
• Passport style photo (x4)

div.label: I understand that the processing of my application will only start upon the submission of these original documents to the SPC office.

div.div: Did your country fall under Transfer list?
Unfortunately, Transfer of driving license is not possible for the selected nationality.
